CHAPTER.VERS:
O LORD God of my salvation, I have cried day night before thee:
for the sons: or, of the sons
Maschil…: or, A Psalm of Heman the Ezrahite, giving instruction
Let my prayer come before thee: incline thy ear to my cry;
For my soul is full of troubles: and my life draweth near to the grave.
I am counted with them that go down into the pit: I am as a man no strength:

Free among the dead, like the slain that lie in the grave, whom thou rememberest no more: and they are cut off from thy hand.
from: or, by
Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit, in darkness, in the deeps.
Thy wrath lieth heavy upon me, and thou hast afflicted with all thy waves. Selah.
Thou hast put away my acquaintance far from me; thou hast made me an abomination to them: shut up, and I cannot come forth.
My eye mourneth by reason of affliction: LORD, I have called daily upon thee, I have stretched out my hands to thee.
Wilt thou show wonders to the dead? shall the dead arise praise thee? Selah.
Shall thy lovingkindness be declared in the grave? thy faithfulness in destruction?
Shall thy wonders be known in the dark? and thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
But to thee have I cried, O LORD; and in the morning shall my prayer come before thee.
LORD, why castest thou off my soul? hidest thou thy face from me?
I afflicted and ready to die from youth up: I suffer thy terrors I am distracted.
Thy fierce wrath goeth over me; thy terrors have cut me off.

They came around me daily like water; they surrounded me together.
daily: or, all the day
Lover and friend hast thou put far from me, my acquaintance into darkness.
